metadata.scope: Static source audit, not a runtime recipe dump or implementation acceptance

GTL.repository: GNSW/GTLCore (same audited commit as local origin AaAdoniSsS/GTLCore)

limitations: Source expressions are not evaluated or loop-expanded.
KubeJS and datapack changes in a target modpack instance are not included.
Factory defaults, variables, later mutations, custom helpers and recipe build hooks require runtime resolution.
RecipeManager does not include every world-driven machine behavior.
